SEC-6N.11 paragraph 06 states that when the right-hand lane is closed, TTC similar to Figure 6P-33 may be used for divided roads, and TA-33 is titled Stationary Lane Closure on a Divided Highway. The long-term duration matches the long-term treatment shown in Figure 6P-33. TA-34 was not selected because the scene provides no evidence of a temporary traffic barrier, and TA-29 was not selected as a primary or cross-reference because sidewalk closure or relocation is not established. The missing lane count does not prevent selection among the mutually exclusive primary applications: the roadway is already classified as multilane and divided, and the closed lane is identified as the right lane. Additional intersection or pedestrian treatments may be added later if the unresolved scene facts establish those conditions.
